{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 thick-cut bone-in [[Cookbook:Lamb|lamb]] loin chops
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 tsp [[Themes in Literature/Isolation and Community/Much Madness|thyme]], finely chopped
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* ½ head [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 4 tsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]

== Procedure ==
#Rub the cut side of the halved garlic head all over lamb chops. [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] with olive oil and rub seasonings into meat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] chops over high heat for 1 ½ minutes. Rotate 90° and cook for another 1 ½ minutes. Flip and repeat these steps on the other side of the chops.
#Move meat to medium heat and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 140°F for medium rare.
#Remove and let rest 7 minutes. Serve warm.
